# autohotkey-test

AutoHotkey v2 scriptlet depot. 75+ scripts across games, productivity, system,
dev tools, and MCP integration. Includes ScriptletCOMBridge HTTP server on
port 10744 for list/run/stop from autohotkey-mcp.

## Docs

- [README](README.md)
- [Repository Status](docs/Repository_Status_Report.md)
- [Bugbash Results](docs/BUGBASH_RESULTS.md)
- [AHK v2 Syntax Reference](docs/AutoHotkey_v2_Syntax_Reference.md)

## Structure

- scriptlets/ — .ahk scripts organized by category
- scriptlets/ai_generated/ — MCP-generated scripts (sandbox)
- ScriptletCOMBridge.ahk — HTTP bridge server on port 10744
- utils/ — linter, batch debugger, compatibility scanner

## Start

- start.bat / start.ps1 — fleet-standard launcher (kills port zombie, starts bridge, opens dashboard)
- start_dashboard.bat / start_dashboard.ps1 — original launchers (still work)

## Port

- 10744: ScriptletCOMBridge HTTP (/scriptlets, /run/:name, /stop/:name, /dashboard)

## Integration

Consumed by autohotkey-mcp via AUTOHOTKEY_SCRIPT_DEPOT env var.
Bridge URL: http://127.0.0.1:10744
